event_name: Date 02 September 2018 Time 15:41 2018 ITALIAN GRAND PRIX 30 August - 02 September 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Incident between cars 5 and 44 in turn 4.
offence: Involved in an alleged incident as defined by Art 38.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence and determined that neither driver was wholy or predominantly at fault for the incident at Turn 4.
